verdict.rationale: WezTerm documents its own native multiplexer for local and remote hosts, with panes, tabs and SSH domains. One user reports fully replacing tmux with it, and another's hands-on report implies tmux runs inside WezTerm, though image support did not work well with tmux. Missing for 10: any documented tmux integration or control mode (tmux -CC), explicit docs on tmux compatibility inside the terminal, and evidence that tmux works cleanly alongside features like images.
